title: security: rbac-v2 enforce kms region pinning and audit logging hardening
author: Aisha Kapoor
description: Motivation: enforce KMS region pinning at RBAC v2 policy evaluation time and harden audit logging around residency decisions to meet regulatory data residency requirements and SRE observability needs; Changes: add policy checks for kms_region_residency and strict deny mode, surface residency decisions in audit logs with structured fields, add end-to-end tests, update docs and Terraform module; Checklist: implement enforcement in rbac evaluator; expose decision metadata to audit pipeline; add unit/integration tests and test vectors; update ops runbook and console dashboards; update terraform module and installer upgrade path; Rollout plan: feature flag gated by feature.rbac_v2_kms_residency, gradual canary over Dedicated regions, flag removal after 2 releases and monitoring stable; Backwards compatibility: policy is opt-in until flag is enabled, existing KMS configs unaffected until rollout; Notes: this PR also fixes a race in KV cache cleanup observed in canary during testing (minor change).
commits_summary: 3 commits: 1) add kms residency enforcement and policy predicates; 2) add structured audit log fields and pipeline hooks; 3) tests, docs, terraform updates and release notes
review_comments: Liam Chen: minor nits, please add more unit tests for deny-paths and an example policy snippet; also call out the expected audit json schema in docs
Aisha Kapoor: added two deny-path unit tests and a sample policy in docs, expanded audit schema section
Priya Nair: can we gate the strict deny by a feature flag? recommend feature.rbac_v2_kms_residency; also request a changelog entry for Dedicated customers
Aisha Kapoor: feature flag added to evaluator and rollout notes updated; changelog entry included
Omar Haddad (security): ran static analyzer on new code, left a comment about sanitizing KMS key identifiers in logs to avoid PII; please address
Aisha Kapoor: sanitized key identifiers before logging and added unit test to assert redaction
ci_checks: ci/unit-tests: fail (flake on TestPolicyEvaluatorRace) -> rerun -> pass
release_notes: Enforce KMS region pinning for RBAC v2 policies (opt-in behind feature flag); Add structured audit logging for residency decisions; Docs + Terraform module updates; Rollout: feature flag controlled canary followed by gradual enablement for Dedicated customers; Backwards compatible until flag enabled
merge_commit_summary: Squash-merged: enforce kms region pinning in rbac-v2 evaluator; emit structured audit fields for residency decisions; add tests, docs, and terraform updates
